assessments.description: Small tasks to probe understanding of content, readings and lectures (Weeks 1 to 6).

assessments.name: Professional Statement
assessments.description: Written statement to be submitted online; an opportunity to formulate initial thinking on three core principles within your role as an educator: principles of inclusion, inclusive educational practices, and behaviour support.

assessments.name: Q&A on presentation
assessments.description: Q&A following group presentation based on scenario; each student in the group will be asked a question based on the group presentation; question to be answered in class verbally or in writing; attendance in class is required.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement

assessments.name: Group Presentation with Visual Aid
assessments.description: Tutorial presentation in final week and submitted work

assessments.name: Field Placement Report
assessments.description: 20 hour fieldwork placement + report. Placement to be confirmed by Week 6. Report consists of reflective journal (1200 words) plus literature review of topic related to your fieldwork observation.
